examTags: 阅读·根据描述判断状态
grammar: adj. 满的；完整的。可作表语 be full，也可作定语修饰名词；full of 表示“装满……”。
collocations: a full glass; be full of books; a full name。
commonMistake: full of 后接名词；描述东西已经满了可说 be full，不要误用 fullly。

example.english: The box is full of old books.
example.chinese: 这个箱子里装满了旧书。

application.prompt: There is no space for another book in the box. The box is ___. A. full B. empty
application.solution: A。解析：没有多余空间说明箱子是满的，full 表示“满的”。

grammar: n. 年级；等级。可数，复数 grades。表示几年级时可说 in Grade 7；Grade 作年级名称时常大写。
collocations: in Grade 7; a good grade; grade six/seventh grade。
commonMistake: 表示“七年级”可说 in Grade 7；不要把 grade（年级/等级）和 class（班级/课）混为一谈。

example.english: My cousin is in Grade 7 this year.
example.chinese: 我表弟今年上七年级。

application.prompt: Mina is in Grade 7. This tells us her school ___. A. grade B. country
application.solution: A。解析：Grade 7 表示七年级，说明她所在的年级。

grammar: n. 同班同学；可数，复数 classmates。classmate 是由 class + mate 构成的合成词。
collocations: a classmate of mine; my classmates; talk with a classmate。
commonMistake: classmate 是可数名词，单数前要有 a、the 或 my 等限定词；复数为 classmates。

example.english: I often read with my classmate Mei.
example.chinese: 我常和同班同学小梅一起读书。

application.prompt: Leo and I study in the same class. Leo is my ___. A. classmate B. country
application.solution: A。解析：同一个班里的同学是 classmate。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与固定搭配
grammar: n. 错误；失误。可数，复数 mistakes。也可作 v. mistake—mistook—mistaken，表示“误认”。
collocations: make a mistake; by mistake; learn from a mistake。
commonMistake: 常说 make a mistake，不说 do a mistake；mistake 作名词时单数前通常有 a。

example.english: I made a mistake in the first question.
example.chinese: 我在第一题中犯了一个错误。

application.prompt: I wrote 17, but the correct number is 71. I made a ___. A. mistake B. hobby
application.solution: A。解析：把数字写错是 mistake，表示“错误”。

grammar: n. 国家；乡村。可数，复数 countries：辅音字母 + y 结尾时，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。
collocations: a big country; different countries; come from a country。
commonMistake: country 的复数是 countries，不是 countrys；country 表示“国家”时通常是可数名词。

example.english: China is a large country.
example.chinese: 中国是一个幅员辽阔的国家。

application.prompt: Japan is a ___. A. country B. classmate
application.solution: A。解析：Japan 是一个国家，country 表示“国家”。

grammar: adj./det. 相同的；通常说 the same + 名词，也可说 the same as ...。
collocations: the same class; the same colour; the same as mine。
commonMistake: same 前通常要有 the：the same book；不要漏掉 the。

example.english: We have the same English teacher.
example.chinese: 我们有同一位英语老师。

application.prompt: Ming and I are in ___ class. A. the same B. same
application.solution: A。解析：same 前通常用定冠词 the，构成 the same class。

grammar: n. 双胞胎之一；adj. 双胞胎的。作名词时可数：a twin、twins；作形容词时修饰名词，如 twin sisters。
collocations: a twin brother; twin sisters; identical twins。
commonMistake: twin 作名词表示双胞胎中的一个，复数 twins；twin sisters 中 twin 作形容词，不加 -s。

example.english: Ella has a twin brother named Evan.
example.chinese: Ella 有一个名叫 Evan 的双胞胎兄弟。

application.prompt: Nina and Tina were born together and are sisters. They are ___. A. twins B. twin
application.solution: A。解析：They 指两个人，作名词时用复数 twins。

grammar: det./pron. 两个都。both + 复数名词；both of + 限定词/代词；作主语时谓语通常用复数。
collocations: both friends; both of us; both ... and ...。
commonMistake: both 指两者，后接复数名词；Both students are ...，不要用单数 is。

example.english: Both of my classmates like tennis.
example.chinese: 我的两位同班同学都喜欢网球。

application.prompt: Both students ___ in Grade 7. A. is B. are
application.solution: B。解析：both 表示两者都，后面的主语 students 是复数，用 are。

grammar: n. 乐队；可数，复数 bands。表示音乐组合时可说 a band 或 a music band。
collocations: a school band; a rock band; play in a band。
commonMistake: band 表示“乐队”时是可数名词：a band、two bands；不要和表示带子的 band 混淆上下文。

example.english: Our school band plays music on Fridays.
example.chinese: 我们学校的乐队每周五演奏音乐。

application.prompt: A group of musicians who play songs together is a ___. A. band B. page
application.solution: A。解析：band 可指一起演奏音乐的乐队。

grammar: n. 锅；罐。可数，复数 pots。具体含义可根据搭配判断，如 cooking pot 或 flower pot。
collocations: a cooking pot; a pot of soup; a flower pot。
commonMistake: pot 的复数直接加 -s：pots；a pot of soup 中 pot 可数，soup 表示锅里的汤。

example.english: Dad cooks the soup in a large pot.
example.chinese: 爸爸用一口大锅煮汤。

application.prompt: Mum cooks noodles in a ___. A. pot B. page
application.solution: A。解析：煮面条用锅，pot 表示“锅”。

grammar: n. 豆腐；通常作不可数名词，不加复数 -s。需要计量时可说 a piece/block of tofu。
collocations: some tofu; a block of tofu; cook tofu。
commonMistake: tofu 通常不可数，不说 a tofu 或 tofus；可用 some tofu 或 a piece of tofu。

example.english: We have tofu and rice for lunch.
example.chinese: 我们午餐吃豆腐和米饭。

application.prompt: There is ___ tofu in the bowl. A. some B. a
application.solution: A。解析：tofu 通常作不可数名词，some 可修饰不可数名词。

grammar: n. 鹦鹉；可数，复数 parrots。单数前通常有 a、the 或物主限定词。
collocations: a pet parrot; a green parrot; parrots can talk。
commonMistake: parrot 是可数名词，单数前要有冠词或限定词；复数直接加 -s：parrots。

example.english: Their parrot can say a few English words.
example.chinese: 他们的鹦鹉会说几个英语单词。

application.prompt: This colourful bird can copy some words. It is a ___. A. parrot B. tennis
application.solution: A。解析：parrot 是鹦鹉，符合会模仿说话的鸟这一描述。

examTags: 语言运用·音乐兴趣表达
grammar: n. 吉他；可数，复数 guitars。表示演奏乐器时常用 play the guitar。
collocations: play the guitar; a guitar lesson; an electric guitar。
commonMistake: 表示“弹吉他”常说 play the guitar；play 后直接接球类运动名词时通常不加 the，如 play tennis。

example.english: My friend can play the guitar very well.
example.chinese: 我的朋友吉他弹得很好。

application.prompt: Which phrase names the activity of playing this instrument? A. play the guitar B. play the tennis
application.solution: A。解析：表示演奏吉他常说 play the guitar；球类运动 tennis 前通常不加 the。

grammar: n. 网球；表示运动项目时通常作不可数名词。球类运动常用 play + 运动名称，不加 the。
collocations: play tennis; a tennis player; a tennis racket。
commonMistake: 表示“打网球”说 play tennis，不说 play the tennis；tennis 作运动名称时通常不加冠词。

example.english: We play tennis after school on Fridays.
example.chinese: 我们每周五放学后打网球。

application.prompt: My classmates and I play ___ after school. A. tennis B. the tennis
application.solution: A。解析：play + 球类运动名称时通常不用 the。

examTags: 阅读·根据语境判断场所
grammar: n. 论坛；讨论会。可数，复数 forums（也可见 fora）。online forum 表示网络论坛。
collocations: an online forum; a discussion forum; post a question on a forum。
commonMistake: forum 是可数名词，单数前通常用 a/an；因开头发音为辅音音素，常说 a forum。

example.english: I found an answer to my question on an online forum.
example.chinese: 我在一个网络论坛上找到了问题的答案。

application.prompt: People post questions and discuss topics on an online ___. A. forum B. guitar
application.solution: A。解析：online forum 是供人发帖讨论的网络论坛。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与数字信息
grammar: n. 页面；书页。可数，复数 pages。页码前常用 on page 5 或 turn to page 5。
collocations: page 10; the first page; turn to the next page。
commonMistake: 说 turn to page 5 时，页码前通常不加 the；泛指某一页时可说 a page。

example.english: Please turn to page twelve and read the story.
example.chinese: 请翻到第十二页并阅读这个故事。

application.prompt: The teacher says, “Open your books and turn to ___.” A. page 12 B. country 12
application.solution: A。解析：page 12 表示第 12 页，符合翻书的课堂指令。

grammar: adv. 甚至；连。常放在要强调的词或短语前；even 可以加强语气，不改变句子主干。
collocations: even a child; even better; not even one。
commonMistake: even 是副词，不是形容词；常放在被强调的词前，如 Even Tom can do it。

example.english: Even my little sister knows this song.
example.chinese: 甚至我妹妹都知道这首歌。

application.prompt: All the students can play the game. ___ the youngest student can play it. A. Even B. Both
application.solution: A。解析：强调“连最小的学生也会”，用 even；both 表示两者都。

grammar: interj. 嘿；喂。常用于引起注意或非正式问候；词形不变，书写时常用逗号隔开称呼对象。
collocations: Hey, Sam!; Hey there!; Hey, look at this!。
commonMistake: hey 语气较随意，适合同学朋友间；正式场合可用 Hello 或 Good morning。

example.english: Hey, Max! Are you free after class?
example.chinese: 嘿，Max！你下课后有空吗？

application.prompt: You see your friend at school. Which is a casual greeting? A. Hey, Ben! B. Good night, Ben!
application.solution: A。解析：Hey 可作随意的见面问候；Good night 通常用于晚上道别或睡前。

examTags: 语言能力·礼貌邀请与回应
grammar: modal v. 可用于礼貌邀请或提供：Would you like + 名词/to do? 后接名词或 to + 动词原形；would 本身不随主语变化。
collocations: Would you like some tea?; Would you like to join us?; I'd like ...。
commonMistake: Would you like 后接名词或 to do，不说 Would you like play；would 后也不加 -s。

example.english: Would you like to play tennis with us?
example.chinese: 你愿意和我们一起打网球吗？

application.prompt: ___ you like to join our school band? A. Would B. Are
application.solution: A。解析：Would you like to do...? 是礼貌邀请的常用表达。

grammar: n. 信息；消息。通常作不可数名词，不加复数 -s；表示一条信息可说 a piece of information。
collocations: some information; a piece of information; information about the club。
commonMistake: information 通常不可数，不说 an information 或 informations；可说 some information / a piece of information。

example.english: We need more information about the tennis club.
example.chinese: 我们需要更多关于网球俱乐部的信息。

application.prompt: There is ___ information about the new class online. A. some B. many
application.solution: A。解析：information 通常不可数，用 some 修饰；many 修饰可数名词复数。

examTags: 语言运用·介绍兴趣爱好
grammar: n. 业余爱好；可数，复数 hobbies：辅音字母 + y 结尾时，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。
collocations: my hobby; have a hobby; hobbies include reading and tennis。
commonMistake: hobby 的复数是 hobbies，不是 hobbys；询问爱好可说 What is your hobby? 或 What are your hobbies?

example.english: My hobby is playing the guitar.
example.chinese: 我的爱好是弹吉他。

application.prompt: Ben likes drawing in his free time. Drawing is his ___. A. hobby B. mistake
application.solution: A。解析：业余时间喜欢做的活动是 hobby，表示“爱好”。

grammar: pron. 我们；第一人称复数主格，作主语。宾格是 us，形容词性物主代词是 our。
collocations: we are classmates; we both like ...; we have ...; we can ...。
commonMistake: 作主语用 we，作动词或介词宾语用 us：We help them；They help us。

example.english: We are classmates in Grade 7.
example.chinese: 我们是七年级的同班同学。

application.prompt: Amy and I are classmates. ___ are both in Grade 7. A. We B. Us
application.solution: A。解析：空格处作句子主语，应使用主格 we。

examTags: 语法·动词搭配与使役结构
grammar: v. 制作；使成为。make—made—made—making。可用 make + 名词；make + 宾语 + 形容词表示“使……变得……”。
collocations: make a poster; make friends; make sb. happy; make a mistake。
commonMistake: 过去式和过去分词是 made；make + 人 + 形容词时不加 be，如 make me happy。

example.english: We make a poster for the school band every month.
example.chinese: 我们每个月为学校乐队制作一张海报。

application.prompt: We ___ a card for our classmate every year. A. make B. makes
application.solution: A。解析：主语 we 是复数，一般现在时用动词原形 make。

examTags: 语言运用·介绍朋友与关系
grammar: n. 朋友；可数，复数 friends。friendly 是形容词“友好的”，不要与 friend 混淆。
collocations: a good friend; make friends with sb.; a friend of mine。
commonMistake: friend 是名词，friendly 是形容词；说“一个朋友”用 a friend。

example.english: Kai is a friend of mine from the tennis club.
example.chinese: Kai 是我在网球俱乐部认识的一位朋友。

application.prompt: Lily is a ___ of mine. A. friend B. friendly
application.solution: A。解析：a 后需要名词，friend 是名词；friendly 是形容词。

examTags: 语法·祈使句与动词原形
grammar: v. 去取；得到。get—got—got（英式常用）/gotten（美式也用）—getting。get + 名词表示拿到或取来某物。
collocations: get a book; get some water; get home; get to school。
commonMistake: 祈使句开头用动词原形：Get the guitar, please；不要在 please 后写 gets。

example.english: Can you get my tennis racket from the classroom?
example.chinese: 你能帮我从教室里拿一下网球拍吗？

application.prompt: Your guitar is in the music room. Please ___ it before class. A. get B. gets
application.solution: A。解析：please 引导的祈使句用动词原形 get。

grammar: 表示知道或认识，通常作状态动词，不常用于进行时；过去式 knew，过去分词 known。主语为 he/she/it 时用 knows。
collocations: know a person；know about sth；know how to do sth
commonMistake: 一般不说 I am knowing；表示“我认识她”用 I know her。

example.english: I know our new English teacher, Ms Lin.
example.chinese: 我认识我们的新英语老师林老师。

application.prompt: Daming has met Mr Liu before. He ___ him. (know)
application.solution: knows

grammar: 介词，表示来源、出发点或时间起点；常用于 be/come from 和 from...to...。
collocations: be from a place；come from；from Monday to Friday
commonMistake: 表示“来自某地”用 be from；from 后接地点或时间起点。

example.english: Mia is from China, and her cousin is from Canada.
example.chinese: 米娅来自中国，她的表姐来自加拿大。

application.prompt: Leo travels ___ Beijing ___ Shanghai. Complete the pair.
application.solution: from; to

grammar: 形容词，可表示年龄大或物品旧；询问年龄常用 How old...?；年龄表达为数字 + years old。
collocations: How old...?；... years old；an old book
commonMistake: 表示“我12岁”说 I am 12 years old，不说 I have 12 years。

example.english: My bicycle is three years old, but it still works well.
example.chinese: 我的自行车有三年了，但仍然很好用。

application.prompt: Ella is twelve. She is twelve years ___.
application.solution: old

examTags: 语法·形容词与时间短语
grammar: 作形容词时可表示“上一个的”或“最后的”；last year/week 常表示刚过去的一年/一周。
collocations: last year；last week；the last lesson
commonMistake: 表示“去年”通常直接说 last year，不在 last 前加 in。

example.english: We met at the school library last year.
example.chinese: 我们去年在学校图书馆见过面。

application.prompt: I am in Grade 7 now. ___ year I was in Grade 6. (last / next)
application.solution: last

grammar: 可数名词，复数为 years；前有具体数字时通常用复数，如 two years。
collocations: this year；next year；a school year；all year
commonMistake: 表示“两个年”要用 two years；one year 用单数。

example.english: A school year has many busy days.
example.chinese: 一个学年里有许多忙碌的日子。

application.prompt: There are twelve months in a ___.
application.solution: year

grammar: 感叹词，用于肯定回答或表示同意；回答含 be 动词的一般疑问句时，后面可重复 be 动词。
collocations: Yes, I am.；Yes, please.；say yes
commonMistake: 回答 Are you...? 时可说 Yes, I am，不能只把问句中的 are 原样重复。

example.english: ‘Are you in Class 2?’ ‘Yes, I am.’
example.chinese: “你在二班吗？”“是的，我在。”

application.prompt: ‘Would you like some water?’ ‘___, please.’ (Yes / No)
application.solution: Yes

grammar: 对男性的称谓，通常放在姓氏或全名之前，首字母大写；英式英语常写 Mr，部分美式英语写 Mr.。
collocations: Mr Chen；Mr Brown；Dear Mr Lee
commonMistake: Mr 放在人名之前且首字母大写；通常不单独放在姓氏之后。

example.english: Mr Chen is our English teacher.
example.chinese: 陈先生是我们的英语老师。

application.prompt: ___ Chen is a male teacher. Choose the correct title: Mr / Ms.
application.solution: Mr

grammar: 形容词性物主代词，表示“我们的”，后面通常接名词；单独作名词性成分时用 ours。
collocations: our class；our school；our English teacher
commonMistake: our 后接名词，如 our desk；不接名词时用 ours，如 The desk is ours。

example.english: Our class has a new English teacher.
example.chinese: 我们班有一位新英语老师。

application.prompt: This is ___ desk; it belongs to our group. (our / ours)
application.solution: our

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: possessive determiners and pronouns

grammar: 作语言名称时是不可数名词；也可作形容词，表示“英语的”。English 首字母要大写。
collocations: study English；speak English；English class；an English book
commonMistake: 表示学科或语言时通常说 study English，不加 an，也不写成小写 english。

example.english: We read an English story in class.
example.chinese: 我们在课堂上读了一个英语故事。

application.prompt: We study ___ on Monday. (English / an English)
application.solution: English

grammar: 可数名词，复数为 teachers；由动词 teach 加后缀 -er 构成，表示“教的人”。
collocations: an English teacher；a science teacher；class teacher
commonMistake: teacher 是表示“教师”的名词，teach 是动词；表示“一位教师”用 a teacher。

example.english: Our English teacher asks clear questions.
example.chinese: 我们的英语老师提问清楚。

application.prompt: A person who teaches a class is a ___. (teach / teacher)
application.solution: teacher

examTags: 语法·疑问代词与限定词
grammar: 用于在有限范围内询问“哪一个/哪些”；可单独作代词，也可放在名词前作限定词。
collocations: which one；which book；which colour
commonMistake: 在几个明确的人或物中选择时常用 which；询问人物身份时通常用 who。

example.english: Which colour do you like, blue or green?
example.chinese: 蓝色和绿色，你喜欢哪一种颜色？

application.prompt: Three pandas are in the picture. ___ one is eating? (Which / Who)
application.solution: Which

grammar: 疑问代词，询问或指代人；作主语时，谓语动词要与其所指的人在语境中保持一致。
collocations: Who is...?；Who are...?；the student who...
commonMistake: 询问“谁”用 who；which 通常用于在有限的人或物中选择。

example.english: Who is your new classmate?
example.chinese: 谁是你的新同学？

application.prompt: ___ is at the door? It is my brother. (Who / Which)
application.solution: Who

grammar: 可数名词，表示一份工作或职位；work 通常作不可数名词表示工作这一活动。
collocations: have a job；get a job；a full-time job
commonMistake: 表示一份工作时说 a job；通常不说 a work。

example.english: My aunt has a job at a school.
example.chinese: 我姑姑在一所学校有一份工作。

application.prompt: My father has a ___ at the hospital. (job / work)
application.solution: job

grammar: 可数名词，表示学生；复数通常加 -s：students。
collocations: a student；a middle school student；student card
commonMistake: 表示两名或更多学生时用 students；不要漏掉复数词尾 -s。

example.english: The students in our class enjoy reading.
example.chinese: 我们班的学生喜欢阅读。

application.prompt: There are thirty ___ in our class. (student)
application.solution: students

grammar: 名词，表示年龄；可用于 at the age of + 数字。询问年龄也常用 How old...?。
collocations: at the age of ten；your age；people of all ages
commonMistake: 询问年龄常用 How old are you?；age 是名词，old 是形容词。

example.english: At the age of six, Nina joined the school music club.
example.chinese: 六岁时，妮娜加入了学校音乐社团。

application.prompt: Nina started learning the piano at the ___ of six. (age / old)
application.solution: age

grammar: 第三人称单数女性人称代词主格，在句中通常作主语；宾格形式是 her，物主限定词是 her。
collocations: she is；she has；she and her friend
commonMistake: she 作主语；动词 be 通常用 is，如 She is a student。

example.english: Lily is from Beijing. She is a student.
example.chinese: 莉莉来自北京。她是一名学生。

application.prompt: Mia is my classmate. ___ is from China. (She / Her)
application.solution: She

grammar: 形容词，表示“最喜欢的”；可放在名词前，也可在 be 动词后作表语。英式拼法 favourite，美式常拼 favorite。
collocations: favourite animal；favourite subject；my favourite is...
commonMistake: 英式拼法 favourite 含 ou；写作时注意同一篇文章拼法保持一致。

example.english: My favourite animal is the panda.
example.chinese: 我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。

application.prompt: I like blue best. Blue is my ___ colour. (favourite)
application.solution: favourite

grammar: 可数名词，指人饲养的动物；复数为 pets。
collocations: have a pet；pet dog；pet shop
commonMistake: 表示一只宠物时用 a pet；表示多只时用 pets。

example.english: They have a pet rabbit at home.
example.chinese: 他们家里养了一只宠物兔。

application.prompt: An animal kept at home for company can be called a ___. (pet / student)
application.solution: pet

grammar: 程度副词，常放在形容词或副词前加强程度，如 very cute、very carefully。
collocations: very good；very cute；very well；thank you very much
commonMistake: very 通常修饰形容词或副词；表达“非常喜欢”说 like...very much，不说 very like。

example.english: The puppy is very small.
example.chinese: 这只小狗非常小。

application.prompt: The puppy is ___ cute. (very / much)
application.solution: very

examTags: 语言运用·人物与动物描写
grammar: 形容词，表示可爱的；可放在名词前，也可放在 be、look 等系动词后。
collocations: a cute puppy；look cute；a cute face
commonMistake: look 作系动词时后接形容词，如 The puppy looks cute。

example.english: The baby panda looks cute in the photo.
example.chinese: 照片里的熊猫宝宝看起来很可爱。

application.prompt: The puppy looks ___. (cute / cutely)
application.solution: cute

grammar: 可作限定词、代词或副词；修饰不可数名词常用 much，询问数量常见 How much...?；many 修饰可数名词复数。
collocations: how much water；much time；very much；much better
commonMistake: much 通常与不可数名词搭配；many 通常与可数名词复数搭配。

example.english: How much water is in your bottle?
example.chinese: 你的水瓶里有多少水？

application.prompt: There isn't ___ juice in the glass. (much / many)
application.solution: much

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: much and many with a noun

grammar: 可数名词，表示学校；复数为 schools。表示上学这一日常活动时常用 go to school；指具体校舍时可说 go to the school。
collocations: go to school；at school；school life；school uniform
commonMistake: 表示“去上学”通常说 go to school；谈到某一所具体学校或校舍时可用 the school。

example.english: My school has a small library.
example.chinese: 我的学校有一个小图书馆。

application.prompt: Our town has two ___. (school)
application.solution: schools

grammar: 专有名词，表示中国，首字母大写，通常不加 the；形容词或语言/国籍表达常用 Chinese。
collocations: in China；from China；China and Canada
commonMistake: 国家名 China 首字母大写；Chinese 可表示“中国的/中国人/中文”，不能互换充当国名。

example.english: My pen pal lives in China.
example.chinese: 我的笔友住在中国。

application.prompt: Ken is from ___. It is a country in East Asia. (China / Chinese)
application.solution: China

grammar: 可数名词，表示熊猫；复数通常为 pandas。
collocations: a giant panda；panda cub；see pandas
commonMistake: 表示两只或更多熊猫时用 pandas；不要漏写复数 -s。

example.english: The panda eats bamboo in the forest.
example.chinese: 熊猫在森林里吃竹子。

application.prompt: We saw three ___ at the zoo. (panda)
application.solution: pandas

grammar: 形容词，表示热的或炎热的；比较级 hotter、最高级 hottest，词尾辅音字母 t 双写后再加 -er/-est。
collocations: hot weather；hot tea；a hot day
commonMistake: hot 的比较级写 hotter，需双写 t；不要写成 hoter。

example.english: It is hot today, so we drink cold water.
example.chinese: 今天很热，所以我们喝凉水。

application.prompt: Today is 35°C and yesterday was 30°C. Today is ___ than yesterday. (hot)
application.solution: hotter

grammar: also 是副词，表示“也、而且”；通常放在实义动词前，be 动词后，也可放在情态动词或第一个助动词后。
collocations: also like music; is also from China; can also play
commonMistake: 常见位置是主语后、实义动词前（I also like music）；be 动词后（She is also here）。

example.english: I like birds, and I also like horses.
example.chinese: 我喜欢鸟，也喜欢马。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I like birds. I ___ like music. A. also  B. very
application.solution: A. also。also 表示“也”；very 不能直接修饰动词 like。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: Also, as well or too?

grammar: live 表示“居住、生活”时常作不及物动词；一般现在时第三人称单数为 lives，过去式和过去分词为 lived。表示居住地常用 live in + 城市/国家。
collocations: live in China; live with my family; live on a farm; live a happy life
commonMistake: 表示“住在某地”时常需介词，如 live in Beijing；主语是 he/she/it 时一般现在时用 lives。

example.english: My grandparents live in Hangzhou.
example.chinese: 我的祖父母住在杭州。

application.prompt: 选词填空：My grandparents ___ in Beijing. A. live  B. lives
application.solution: A. live。主语 grandparents 是复数，谓语用动词原形 live。

grammar: with 是介词，可表示和某人一起、带有某物或使用某工具；介词后接名词或宾格代词。
collocations: with my parents; a house with a garden; write with a pen; play with friends
commonMistake: with 后接宾格代词，如 with me、with them；不能说 with I 或 with they。

example.english: I often play football with my sister.
example.chinese: 我常和姐姐/妹妹一起踢足球。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I play sports with ___. A. them  B. they
application.solution: A. them。with 是介词，后接宾格代词 them。

grammar: parent 是可数名词，指父亲或母亲中的一位；复数 parents 常指父母双方。
collocations: a parent; my parents; parent and child; meet her parents
commonMistake: parent 是单数，parents 是复数；表示父母双方时通常用 my/your/his/her parents。

example.english: Both my parents love music.
example.chinese: 我的父母都喜欢音乐。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Both my ___ are at home. A. parent  B. parents
application.solution: B. parents。both 表示两者都，后面用复数 parents。

grammar: Chinese 可作形容词，表示“中国的、中国人的”；也可作名词表示汉语或中国人。表示汉语时通常作不可数名词；词首字母要大写。
collocations: Chinese food; Chinese music; speak Chinese; Chinese people
commonMistake: 国名 China 和国籍/语言 Chinese 不同；Chinese 必须大写。表达“一位中国人”可说 a Chinese person。

example.english: My parents speak Chinese at home.
example.chinese: 我父母在家说汉语。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We speak ___ at home. A. Chinese  B. China
application.solution: A. Chinese。speak 后接语言名称 Chinese；China 是国名。

grammar: food 通常作不可数名词，表示食物总称；表示不同种类的食物时可用 foods。
collocations: some food; a lot of food; food and drink; a kind of food
commonMistake: 表示一般的食物时通常不说 a food 或 foods；可说 some food、much food 或 a piece of food。

example.english: There is some food for the birds near the wall.
example.chinese: 墙边有一些给鸟吃的食物。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We don’t have much ___ for lunch. A. food  B. foods
application.solution: A. food。much 修饰不可数名词；food 表示食物总称时通常不可数。

grammar: 表示“大量、许多”时常用整体表达 a lot (of)；a lot of 后可接可数名词复数或不可数名词，名词已知时可省略。
collocations: a lot of birds; a lot of food; a lot to do; like music a lot
commonMistake: 表达“大量的……”时通常要说 a lot of + 名词，不能漏掉 a 或 of；可说 a lot of birds/a lot of food。

example.english: There are a lot of birds on the wall.
example.chinese: 墙上有很多鸟。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There are a lot of ___ in the tree. A. birds  B. bird
application.solution: A. birds。a lot of 后接可数名词复数 birds。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: A lot of and lots of

grammar: about 作介词可表示“关于”，后接名词、代词或动名词；作副词可表示“大约”，常放在数字或时间前。
collocations: a book about music; talk about family; about two hours; about ten years ago
commonMistake: talk about sth 表示“谈论某事”；但 discuss 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不说 discuss about sth。

example.english: We are talking about our family.
example.chinese: 我们正在谈论我们的家庭。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The book is ___ birds. A. about  B. ago
application.solution: A. about。about 作介词表示“关于”，后接名词 birds；ago 放在时间表达后。

grammar: wall 是可数名词，单数前常用 a/the，复数为 walls；物品贴在墙面上常用 on the wall。
collocations: a high wall; on the wall; behind the wall; a wall of a house
commonMistake: 说照片、钟表挂在墙面上时通常用 on the wall；不要把 wall 的复数写成 wall’s。

example.english: There is a picture of my family on the wall.
example.chinese: 墙上有一张我家的照片。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There is a clock ___ the wall. A. on  B. at
application.solution: A. on。表示钟表挂在墙面上，使用 on the wall。

grammar: all 可作限定词放在名词前，也可作代词独立指代整体；常见结构有 all the students、all of them。
collocations: all my family; all the birds; all of us; all day
commonMistake: all of 后接代词时要用宾格，如 all of them；修饰名词时可说 all students 或 all the students。

example.english: All the birds are in the tree.
example.chinese: 所有的鸟都在树上。

application.prompt: 选词填空：All the birds ___ in the tree. A. are  B. is
application.solution: A. are。all 修饰复数名词 birds，谓语用 are。

grammar: hour 是可数名词，表示一小时；单数前用 an，因为 h 不发音，hour 以元音音素开头。
collocations: an hour; half an hour; two hours; an hour ago
commonMistake: hour 的 h 不发音，因此说 an hour，不说 a hour；复数为 hours。

example.english: It takes about an hour to visit the farm.
example.chinese: 参观这个农场大约需要一小时。

application.prompt: 选词填空：It takes me ___ hour to get to school. A. an  B. a
application.solution: A. an。hour 的 h 不发音，首音是元音音素，前用 an。

grammar: ago 是副词，放在表示时间长度的词语后，表示“距今……以前”；通常与一般过去时连用。
collocations: two days ago; an hour ago; a long time ago; years ago
commonMistake: ago 放在时间表达后，如 three years ago；不能放在时间表达前，也不与一般现在时搭配表示过去。

example.english: My family moved here two years ago.
example.chinese: 我家两年前搬到了这里。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We visited the farm three days ___. A. ago  B. after
application.solution: A. ago。ago 放在时间长度 three days 后，表示“……以前”。

grammar: family 是可数集体名词，复数为 families；把家庭看作整体时谓语常用单数，强调成员时英式英语也可用复数。
collocations: my family; a large family; family members; family life
commonMistake: family 的复数是 families（辅音字母 + y 变 y 为 ies）；单数前可用 a，如 a family。

example.english: My family has five people.
example.chinese: 我家有五口人。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There are two ___ in this story. A. families  B. family
application.solution: A. families。two 后接可数名词复数；family 的复数拼作 families。

grammar: bird 是可数名词，复数为 birds；表示一只鸟时，单数前通常用 a。
collocations: a small bird; a bird on the wall; feed the birds; birds in a tree
commonMistake: 表示多只鸟时要用 birds；不要把 bird 的复数写成 bird’s，后者通常表示“鸟的”。

example.english: A small bird is sitting on the wall.
example.chinese: 一只小鸟正停在墙上。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The ___ is singing in the tree. A. bird  B. birds
application.solution: A. bird。谓语 is 为单数，此处主语用 bird。

grammar: speak 表示说话或说某种语言；第三人称单数为 speaks，过去式 spoke，过去分词 spoken。表示会某种语言时，speak 后直接接语言名。
collocations: speak Chinese; speak English; speak to my parent; speak with friends
commonMistake: 表示“会说某种语言”时直接说 speak English，不必加 in；注意 speak–spoke–spoken 的不规则变化。

example.english: They speak Chinese at home.
example.chinese: 他们在家说汉语。

application.prompt: 选词填空：They ___ English after class. A. speak  B. speaks
application.solution: A. speak。主语 they 是复数，谓语用动词原形 speak。

grammar: sport 可数时表示一种运动项目，复数为 sports；英式英语中 sport 也可作不可数名词表示一般体育活动，美式英语常用 sports。
collocations: a team sport; play sports; do sport; sports and music
commonMistake: 表示一种运动项目时用 a sport；表示一般运动活动时英式英语可用 sport，美式英语常用 sports。

example.english: Basketball is a team sport.
example.chinese: 篮球是一项团队运动。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Basketball is a team ___. A. sport  B. sports
application.solution: A. sport。a team 后需接单数可数名词 sport。

grammar: often 是频度副词，常放在实义动词前、be 动词后，也可放在句末；how often 用于询问频率。
collocations: often play sports; often listen to music; how often; not often
commonMistake: 一般把 often 放在实义动词前，如 I often play；be 动词后，如 She is often at home。

example.english: I often listen to music with my family.
example.chinese: 我常和家人一起听音乐。

application.prompt: 选出自然的语序：A. I often play basketball.  B. I play often basketball.
application.solution: A。频度副词 often 通常放在实义动词 play 前。

grammar: play 表示参加运动、游戏或演奏乐器；一般现在时第三人称单数为 plays，过去式和过去分词为 played。运动项目前通常不加冠词，乐器前常用 the。
collocations: play basketball; play with friends; play a game; play the piano
commonMistake: 表示进行球类运动时通常说 play basketball/football，不说 play a basketball；演奏乐器常说 play the piano。

example.english: We play sports with our friends after school.
example.chinese: 放学后我们和朋友一起运动。

application.prompt: 选词填空：They ___ football every Friday. A. play  B. play a
application.solution: A. play。表示参加足球运动时说 play football，运动名称前通常不加 a。

grammar: after 作介词时后接名词或动名词；作连词时后接完整句子（主语 + 谓语）。表示将来时，after 从句通常用一般现在时。
collocations: after school; after dinner; after playing sport; after we get home
commonMistake: after + 名词/动名词，或 after + 主语 + 谓语；表示将来时，从句用一般现在时，如 after we get home。

example.english: We play sports after we finish our homework.
example.chinese: 我们做完作业后运动。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We eat dinner after ___. A. we get home  B. home
application.solution: A. we get home。after 作连词时后接主语 we 和谓语 get；after home 结构不完整。

grammar: want 表示想要，可接名词/代词作宾语，也可用 want to do sth；第三人称单数为 wants，过去式为 wanted。
collocations: want some food; want to play; want to write; want sb to do sth
commonMistake: want 后接动词时通常要用 to，如 want to play；不能说 want play。

example.english: I want to write a letter to my grandpa.
example.chinese: 我想给爷爷/外公写一封信。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I want ___ my grandparents this weekend. A. to visit  B. visit
application.solution: A. to visit。want 后接动词时用 to + 动词原形。

grammar: be 是系动词和助动词；一般现在时 am/is/are 随主语变化，过去式为 was/were，过去分词 been，现在分词 being。
collocations: be happy; be at home; be from China; be a student
commonMistake: be 动词要与主语一致：I am，he/she/it is，you/we/they are；不要把 he is 和 they are 混用。

example.english: We are in the same class.
example.chinese: 我们在同一个班。

application.prompt: 选词填空：He ___ my classmate. A. is  B. are
application.solution: A. is。主语 he 是第三人称单数，对应 be 动词 is。

grammar: place 作“地方、地点”时是可数名词，复数为 places；可用 a place to do sth 表示“做某事的地方”。
collocations: a nice place; a place to live; place of interest; in this place
commonMistake: place 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the/物主限定词；不要漏掉冠词说 It is good place。

example.english: The park is a good place to play sports.
example.chinese: 公园是运动的好地方。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The park is a good ___ to play football. A. place  B. music
application.solution: A. place。a good place to play football 表示“踢足球的好地方”。

grammar: music 表示音乐时通常是不可数名词，不用 a，也通常没有复数形式；表示一首乐曲可说 a piece of music。
collocations: listen to music; play music; Chinese music; a piece of music
commonMistake: 表示一般的音乐时不说 a music 或 musics；listen 后接音乐时要用 listen to music。

example.english: I often listen to music with my parents.
example.chinese: 我常和父母一起听音乐。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There is some ___ playing in the room. A. music  B. musics
application.solution: A. music。music 表示一般的音乐时是不可数名词，不加复数 -s。

grammar: love 可作动词表示“喜爱、爱”，也可作名词表示“爱”；作动词时可接名词/代词或 to do/doing。
collocations: love music; love my family; love doing sports; love for music
commonMistake: love 作动词时可直接接宾语，如 love music；love 作名词时常用 love for sth 表示对某事物的热爱。

example.english: My friends love music and sports.
example.chinese: 我的朋友们喜欢音乐和运动。

application.prompt: 选词填空：My friends ___ music. A. love  B. loves
application.solution: A. love。主语 friends 是复数，谓语用动词原形 love。

grammar: write 表示写；过去式 wrote，过去分词 written。可接写的内容作宾语，也可用 write to sb 表示给某人写信/消息。
collocations: write a letter; write a story; write to my parent; write down a name
commonMistake: write–wrote–written 是不规则变化；表示“给某人写信”常用 write to sb。

example.english: I write about my family in my notebook.
example.chinese: 我在笔记本里写我的家庭。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Yesterday, I ___ a note to my mom. A. wrote  B. write
application.solution: A. wrote。Yesterday 表示过去，write 的过去式是 wrote。
